title: Reduce major cardiovascular events through approved obesity pharmacotherapy

concept.text: Demonstrate that an obesity medicine reduces cardiovascular death, myocardial infarction or stroke, beyond showing weight reduction. SELECT established this benefit for semaglutide in people with established cardiovascular disease and overweight or obesity, without diabetes. Proposed completion test: FDA cardiovascular-risk-reduction indication based on an event-driven randomized outcomes trial with the upper 95% confidence bound for the three-point MACE hazard ratio below 1. Test set by: FDA; SELECT prespecified the MACE composite. Its 17,604 participants supplied the decisive clinical-outcomes evidence. Reported achieved: FDA approved Wegovy's cardiovascular-risk-reduction indication on 8 March 2024; SELECT reported MACE in 6.5% versus 8.0%, hazard ratio 0.80. Overlaps: END-05, CAR-02. Sources given: [FDA cardiovascular indication announcement](https://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-treatment-reduce-risk-serious-heart-problems-specifically-adults-obesity-or) ; [FDA Wegovy label with SELECT results](https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/label/2024/215256s015lbl.pdf).
